entries.title: Return of borrowed widgets
entries.text: TEST FIXTURE ONLY - NOT REAL LAW. Section 1 of the Fictional Widget Testing Act, 2000: Any person who borrows a widget shall return the widget to the lender within thirty days.

entries.title: No fee on return
entries.text: TEST FIXTURE ONLY - NOT REAL LAW. Section 2 of the Fictional Widget Testing Act, 2000: A lender shall not charge any fee for the return of a widget.
